05.03 Complete Specification 
Complete Specification is a techno -legal document which fully and 
particularly describes the invention and disclose s the best method of 
performing the invention. 
As a complete s pecification is an important document in the patent 
proceedings, it is advised that it should be drafted with utmost care 
without any ambiguity. 
It is mandatory on the part of applicant to discl ose fully and 
particularly various features constituting the invention. Disclosure of 
invention in a complete specification must be such that a person of 
average skill and average knowledge in India should be able to 
perform the invention based on what is disclosed in the specification.
